newsList.title: Category Extensions Page
newsList.body:
Hello Nerf Test Range Runners,

We now have a Category Extensions Page! 

This page is mainly for high score categories and categories that are out of place on the main boards.

You can find the leaderboards linked under the category selection scroll down or right here https://www.speedrun.com

game.name: Nerf Test Range
game.rules: If you do not timestamp your runs, it will be rejected. This is due to the amount of runs we get in the queue that are not timestamped. Follow all SRC rules, and use common sense.

categories.name: 10,000,000 Points
categories.rules:
Get the specified amount of points as fast as possible. Use in-game time to determine time.

Example: 48 seconds left = 12 seconds

categories.name: All Tests
categories.rules: Complete all of the tests with all the guns in the specified category as fast as possible. Time starts when pressing launch and ends when the results screen for the final test is complete.

categories.name: 5,000,000 Points
categories.rules:
Get the specified amount of points as fast as possible. Use in-game time to determine time.

Example: 48 seconds left = 12 seconds

categories.name: All N-Strike Elite Blasters
categories.rules:
Complete the specified test with all the guns in the N-Strike Elite category as fast as possible. Time starts when pressing launch and ends when the last specified score is reached.

Due to blasters changing frequently, you do not have to do the stared blasters.
